title: Sparkly wristwatch
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fff8a0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffcc00"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Sparkles around the watch -->
  <!-- Top left sparkle -->
  <polygon points="18,18 20,13 22,18 27,20 22,22 20,27 18,22 13,20" fill="#ffe680" />
  <!-- Top right sparkle -->
  <polygon points="82,16 84,11 86,16 91,18 86,20 84,25 82,20 77,18" fill="#fff2a8" />
  <!-- Bottom left sparkle -->
  <polygon points="15,78 17,73 19,78 24,80 19,82 17,87 15,82 10,80" fill="#fff2a8" />
  <!-- Bottom right sparkle -->
  <polygon points="85,80 87,75 89,80 94,82 89,84 87,89 85,84 80,82" fill="#ffe680" />
  <!-- Small right sparkle -->
  <polygon points="92,45 93,41 94,45 98,46 94,47 93,51 92,47 88,46" fill="#fff7cc" />
  <!-- Small left sparkle -->
  <polygon points="8,55 9,51 10,55 14,56 10,57 9,61 8,57 4,56" fill="#fff7cc" />

  <!-- Watch strap top -->
  <rect x="38" y="5" width="24" height="20" rx="4" fill="#5a4a8a" />
  <rect x="40" y="8" width="20" height="14" rx="2" fill="#7a6aaa" />

  <!-- Watch strap bottom -->
  <rect x="38" y="75" width="24" height="20" rx="4" fill="#5a4a8a" />
  <rect x="40" y="78" width="20" height="14" rx="2" fill="#7a6aaa" />

  <!-- Watch case / bezel -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="27" fill="#c8a84a" />
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="24" fill="#e8c860" />
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="21" fill="#f0d870" />

  <!-- Watch face (dark screen) -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="19" fill="#1a1a3a" />

  <!-- Hour markers -->
  <rect x="49" y="33" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#aaddff" />
  <rect x="49" y="62" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#aaddff" />
  <rect x="33" y="49" width="5" height="2" rx="1" fill="#aaddff" />
  <rect x="62" y="49" width="5" height="2" rx="1" fill="#aaddff" />

  <!-- Clock hands -->
  <!-- Hour hand -->
  <line x1="50" y1="50" x2="50" y2="38" stroke="#aaddff" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" />
  <!-- Minute hand -->
  <line x1="50" y1="50" x2="60" y2="44" stroke="#88ddff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" />

  <!-- Center dot -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="2.5" fill="#ffcc00" />

  <!-- Crown -->
  <rect x="76" y="47" width="5" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#d4a840" />
  <rect x="77" y="48" width="3" height="4" rx="1" fill="#f0d870" />

  <!-- Strap buckle top -->
  <rect x="42" y="4" width="16" height="3" rx="1" fill="#9a8aba" />

  <!-- Strap buckle bottom -->
  <rect x="42" y="93" width="16" height="3" rx="1" fill="#9a8aba" />

  <!-- Extra sparkle near crown -->
  <polygon points="87,50 88,46 89,50 93,51 89,52 88,56 87,52 83,51" fill="#fff7cc" />

  <!-- Small twinkle dots -->
  <circle cx="20" cy="40" r="1.5" fill="#ffe680" />
  <circle cx="80" cy="60" r="1.5" fill="#ffe680" />
  <circle cx="25" cy="65" r="1" fill="#fff2a8" />
  <circle cx="72" cy="30" r="1" fill="#fff2a8" />
</svg>
